title: [29.X]-Production Order Fails to Finish Due to Quantity Rounding Difference Between Component Consumption and Item Tracking Quantity - Copy
summary: Fixed a production order finishing failure caused by quantity rounding differences between component consumption and item tracking quantities.
key_points: Addresses rounding discrepancies in manufacturing cost calculations
Prevents production orders from getting stuck during finalization
Improves handling of component quantity tracking in item tracking scenarios
Includes test coverage for the production order completion scenario
